template.name: CorrTime
template.entry_long: adx(high, low, close,{p0}) > {p0} and std(close,{p1}) / close > {p1} and crossabove(close, sma(close,{p2}))
template.exit_long: crossbelow(close, sma(close,10)) or adx(high, low, close,14) < 20
template.notes: Pearson/Spearman/Kendall/Fechner correlation of price with time is not expressible, so the change in price-time coupling is approximated by a close crossing the short average while the documented gates are kept: ADX above 25 (AdxLevel default) and a Bollinger-equivalent width floor replacing BollingerSpreadMin/Max in pips. The trading window, correlation limits, reverse mode, pip-based risk and MaxOpenOrders are unsupported.
